notes.title: Ver 2.1.0 Proximity Voice Chat Update!
notes.content:
☆ New Features

Voice chat has been added to multiplayer! You can now talk to nearby players with Proximity Voice Chat.

Friend invitation feature has been added.

☆ Fixes

Improved unstable behavior at low FPS (e.g. issues like slower movement).

Reduced rollback caused by desynchronization between host and client.

Fixed an issue where loading would not complete when starting multiplayer.

Previously, the processing load was increased to emphasize the appearance, but now the appearance can be sacrificed and the processing load lowered according to the rendering quality of the settings.

notes.title: What to do if you can't find a room ID
notes.content:
If you cannot find a room after searching for an ID in multiplayer, the player you are playing with may have a different Steam download region setting.
Go to Steam->Settings->Downloads->Download Region
and try adjusting the settings accordingly.
